title: Consanguinity
summary: CONSANGUINITY, noun [Latin , blood.] The relation of persons by blood; the relation or connection of persons descended from the same stock or common ancestor, in distinction from affinity or relation

inlines.v: CONSANGUINITY, noun [Latin , blood.] The relation of persons by blood; the relation or connection of persons descended from the same stock or common ancestor, in distinction from affinity or relation by marriage. It is lineal or collateral.
